messages:
ana: Quick follow-up from last night's Redis OOM postmortem — we sketched remediation but need clear owners + RACI and a short timeline. main ask: someone to own the infra change ticket + verify recurrence tests.
leo: I'll create the Jira for infra work. assigning RED-2309 to a primary owner and RED-2310 for the regression test suite. link when created.
jasper: I can pick up RED-2309 (infra change). plan: add cgroup memory limits on batch workers, add graceful OOM handler, and rollout via canary. ETA: EOD Friday for PR + infra plan. @maria ok if I own verification? :thumbsup:
maria: sounds good. i'll own RED-2310 (regression tests). will add two prompt-driven load tests and a nightly mem-smoke job. ETA: Tue next week.
sre-oncall-bot: Postmortem created: PM-2024-042. Reminder: link remediation tickets in the postmortem and mark owners.
leo: RED-2309 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-2309 - jasper assigned. Please put exact rollback steps in the ticket.
jasper: adding acceptance criteria now: 1) no OOM on 4h load test at peak 2) service latency not degraded >5% 3) documented rollback steps. Quick snippet I'll include in the ticket: ```systemctl set-property redwood-batch.service MemoryMax=16G``` and a graceful handler patch to catch OOM signals.
ops-manager: RACI check: jasper = R, maria = A/C for tests, leo = I (creates + tracks), ana = C (postmortem owner). If we need vendor sign-off for on-prem images, loop in infra-ops.
maria: noted on RACI. adding test schedule to RED-2310. also flagging a recurring pattern: similar memory spikes on 3 dates last quarter — i'll attach a small graph to the ticket.
nana: (typo) ana: @ops-manager can we set a deadline for end-to-end verification? If tests are green, we should close remediation within 2 sprints.
ops-manager: Agreed — target: close by sprint end (2 weeks). If blocked, escalate to leadership during weekly ops sync.
leo: tagging in postmortem now with both RED-2309 & RED-2310. Also adding a short rollback runbook section and a playbook snippet for oncall: "If Redis OOM recurs: 1) scale batch workers to 0; 2) apply MemoryMax override; 3) rollback recent deploys".
jasper: starting PR now, will post link in thread when ready. :eyes:
maria: once PR + tests are green i'll run the 4h smoke and report results here.
ops-manager: Thanks all — please update ticket comments instead of burying fixes in PRs. We'll review the RACI in next postmortem follow-up meeting. :calendar:
jasper: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/512 - includes systemd change + handler. calling out config: MemoryMax=16G and a feature flag to enable handler.
maria: kicked off nightly mem-smoke. first run 30m from now, i'll post outcome.
sre-oncall-bot: Jira RED-2309 transitioned to In Progress by jasper.
nana: (typo) ana: thx everyone, great follow-up. closing loop once tests pass.
_meta: generated for dataset: postmortem action assignment thread
